mintAuthority.summary: nBASIS Teller and Manager are both owned by the same 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 (Safe v1.3.0, no modules, no guard) on Ethereum, and fresh 2026-09-05 reads show the same ownership on BSC. The nBASIS BoringVault token is directly deployed and non-upgradeable on Ethereum, Plume, Plasma, and BSC; on BSC it carries the issuer's 18-decimal configuration, the same VfiTimelock 0x34e8bb9e0fa50d63bfca1d8e83ddba0d9fd5c062 owner (172,800-second minimum delay; the Safe holds proposer and canceller roles on it), and a local BNB USDT NestVault 0xf388e7dc2b8e264b9b4149f3981aa5208bd5f3c3 also owned by the VfiTimelock. The BSC Safe's modules state could not be read this pass, so no BSC Safe control row is authored.

controls.label: Nest Basis Vault Teller (issuance/redemption) — BSC
controls.evidence: At BSC block 120073502 on 2026-09-05, owner() on the nBASIS Teller 0xAD60d43a33cA26e40eAcc5BBc60f1C7136FFB89b (deployed at the same address as on Ethereum) returned the 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982. On BSC that Safe has threshold 3, six owners, the Safe v1.3.0 L1 singleton 0xfb1bffc9d739b8d520daf37df666da4c687191ea at slot 0, and a zero guard slot. Nest's registry lists this Teller with a local BNB USDT NestVault 0xf388e7dc2b8e264b9b4149f3981aa5208bd5f3c3 (chainId 56 USDT 0x55d398326f99059ff775485246999027b3197955) whose owner() is the VfiTimelock 0x34e8bb9e0fa50d63bfca1d8e83ddba0d9fd5c062 with getMinDelay() 172800 and the Safe holding PROPOSER_ROLE and CANCELLER_ROLE. A complete Safe modules read on BSC was not obtainable this pass, so no BSC Safe control row is authored.

controls.label: Nest Basis Vault Manager (strategy/admin) — BSC

review.evidence: Historical authority observations remain at their original pins. Both nBASIS Teller and Manager returned owner 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 at Ethereum block 25295023, a 3-of-6 Safe v1.3.0 with no modules or guard. The July 21 review found zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin and beacon slots on Ethereum block 25580348, Plume block 82434036 and Plasma block 27687550; the directly deployed BoringVault has no upgradeTo or upgradeToAndCall. The owner can change issuance authorization without an independent economic cap. September 5 BSC observations remain blocks 120070151 and 120073502: the 18-decimal token owner is VfiTimelock 0x34e8bb9e0fa50d63bfca1d8e83ddba0d9fd5c062, Teller and Manager are owned by the same Safe, Manager vault() names the token, and the Timelock minimum delay is 172800 seconds with the Safe as proposer and canceller. BSC Safe modules remain unread and no BSC Safe control row is authored. World Chain and Solana representation powers remain Bridge Risk. Favorable-credit correction researched 2026-10-20 by FD27: the former continuous reconciliation claim was inferred from issuer-operated positions, price and supplyByChain fields, not an explicit recurring complete supply-to-backing reconciliation procedure. The exact current positions response has supplyRaw null, mixed 6/18-decimal chain rows and no common observation clock or reconciled liability perimeter. Current operations, terms and audit disclosures describe NAV inputs and technical controls but do not establish the missing whole-liability process or cadence. Reconciliation is unknown, not a finding that none exists. Nest DAO LLC's corporate investment license is not token-specific prudential supervision. Known unbounded authority and all original authority/review pins remain unchanged.
